title: Emission - a signed declaration of a range of serial numbers (Section 5)
description: Printing the whole range costs one signature. Forms are derived from the emission deterministically and do not exist as separate documents.

class.description: Distinguishes the logging regime, not the format: a receipt is structured identically in all three classes (Section 10).

issued_at.description: Provides the lower time bound for any receipt on a form of this emission (Section 6).
